theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Cruise Ship Capsizes After Tanker Collision in New Orleans
top_news.summary: All passengers and crew members aboard a river cruise ship that capsized after a tanker collision in New Orleans on Friday were accounted for, with 32 people hospitalized but none critically injured, according to Mayor Helena Moreno. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Nvidia’s Board Failed Jensen Huang: Randall Peterson
top_news.summary: Randall Peterson, founding director of the London Business School Leadership Institute, believes the board of Nvidia failed both the company and Huang. He speaks with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close”. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Exemplar Luxury Group CEO on the Company’s Second Life
top_news.summary: Geoffroy van Raemdonck said Exemplar Luxury Group is financially stronger after Saks emerged from bankruptcy. He emphasized reaching that goal through customer loyalty, full-price sales and profitable growth that supports reinvestment and strengthens relationships with brands. Geoffroy van Raemdonck speaks with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Big Take: The Climate Is Changing in Ways Models Couldn’t Predict
top_news.summary: COP31 aims to set new goals to bring down emissions as climate change outpaces scientists’ predictions and disasters drive billions of dollars of losses. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Jeff Currie Says He’s Bearish on Copper Due to China
top_news.summary:
Jeff Currie, CEO and founder at Real Macro and senior adviser at Carlyle, says gold’s retreat reflects a shortage of dollar liquidity. He also discusses the global oil industry in an interview with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close.”

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas on Her Company Vision
top_news.summary: Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss her vision for the company since taking over the helm two months ago, how she plans to strategize the company’s business and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Tanker Hits Cruise Ship in New Orleans, Triggering Rescue
top_news.summary: A tanker collided with a docked river cruise ship on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, leaving the smaller vessel partly submerged and setting off a rescue operation. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
top_news.summary: US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control, an extraordinary action that threatens to disrupt travel across the globe. The Federal Aviation Administration said in an advisory notice on its website on Friday that the ground stop affects all US airports and departing flights should remain grounded until further notice. It cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.”  Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head Aerospace, Defense & Airl

top_news.title: US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
top_news.summary: America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. Boston Fed Principal Economist and Policy Advisor Paul Willen says soaring construction costs are making many new housing projects financially unworkable, even after they’ve already won approval. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged. (Source: Bloomberg)
